# Rule reference

<!-- Generated by `python -m app.rule_docs`. Do not edit by hand. -->

79 deterministic rules. Each returns `PASS`, `FAIL` or `REVIEW`, with the text or figures it relied on and a confidence. Document-specific rules stay silent on other document types.

A passing result means a document is internally consistent or agrees with the others. It does not mean the document is correct. The legal references come from the authors' reading of the Companies Act, 2013, the Standards on Auditing, the CGST Rules and AS 3 / Ind AS 7; they have not been reviewed by a qualified professional and should be confirmed before anyone relies on a finding.

How to read it: a `FAIL` means the rule's condition is not met. A `REVIEW` means a person should look, because the evidence is incomplete or there may be an innocent explanation.

## Balance sheet equation (original rule)

Total assets against total liabilities plus equity, current year.

| Rule | Check | Applies to |
|---|---|---|
| `INDAS-FS-001` | Balance-sheet equation check | balance sheet |

## Data quality

A heuristic, not a regulatory requirement.

| Rule | Check | Applies to |
|---|---|---|
| `DATA-QUALITY-001` | Revenue sign check | balance sheet, other, profit and loss |

## Balance sheet

Both-year balance, sub-totals, line items, Schedule III headings, comparatives, note totals, signatures and UDIN.

| Rule | Check | Applies to |
|---|---|---|
| `FSBS-001` | Balance sheet balances in both years | balance sheet, profit and loss |
| `FSBS-002` | Sub-totals add up to the balance sheet totals | balance sheet, profit and loss |
| `FSBS-003` | Balance sheet line items add up to their sections | balance sheet, profit and loss |
| `FSBS-004` | Schedule III headings on the balance sheet | balance sheet, profit and loss |
| `FSBS-005` | Comparative figures and units stated | balance sheet, profit and loss |
| `FSBS-006` | Note totals agree with the statements | balance sheet, profit and loss |
| `FSBS-007` | Statements signed by directors and auditor, with UDIN | balance sheet, profit and loss |

## Statement of profit and loss

Schedule III headings, expense totals, profit before and after tax, earnings per share.

| Rule | Check | Applies to |
|---|---|---|
| `FSPL-001` | Schedule III headings on the statement of profit and loss | balance sheet, profit and loss |
| `FSPL-002` | Expense lines add up to total expenses | balance sheet, profit and loss |
| `FSPL-003` | Total income less total expenses equals profit before tax | balance sheet, profit and loss |
| `FSPL-004` | Profit before tax less tax equals profit for the year | balance sheet, profit and loss |
| `FSPL-005` | Earnings per share consistent with profit and share capital | balance sheet, profit and loss |

## Across the statements

Links between the balance sheet and the statement of profit and loss.

| Rule | Check | Applies to |
|---|---|---|
| `FSX-001` | Reserves move by the profit or loss for the year | balance sheet, profit and loss |

## Cash flow statement (AS 3 / Ind AS 7)

Structure, arithmetic in both years, continuity, and agreement with the other statements.

| Rule | Check | Applies to |
|---|---|---|
| `CFS-001` | Cash flow statement has all required parts (AS 3 / Ind AS 7) | balance sheet, cash flow, profit and loss |
| `CFS-002` | Operating activities add up | balance sheet, cash flow, profit and loss |
| `CFS-003` | Investing and financing totals add up | balance sheet, cash flow, profit and loss |
| `CFS-004` | Net change in cash equals A + B + C | balance sheet, cash flow, profit and loss |
| `CFS-005` | Opening cash plus net change equals closing cash | balance sheet, cash flow, profit and loss |
| `CFS-006` | Opening cash equals the prior year's closing cash | balance sheet, cash flow, profit and loss |
| `CFS-007` | Closing cash agrees with the balance sheet | balance sheet, cash flow, profit and loss |
| `CFS-008` | Profit, depreciation and finance cost agree with the statement of profit and loss | balance sheet, cash flow, profit and loss |
| `CFS-009` | Cash flow statement included (s.2(40)) | balance sheet, cash flow, profit and loss |

## Cross-document checks

Compare the Directors' Report, Auditor's Report, statements, notice and invoice with each other.

| Rule | Check | Applies to |
|---|---|---|
| `XDOC-001` | Company name and CIN agree across documents | two or more documents |
| `XDOC-002` | Financial year-end agrees across documents | two or more documents |
| `XDOC-003` | Auditor named consistently across documents | two or more documents |
| `XDOC-004` | Documents are signed in a sensible order | two or more documents |
| `XDOC-005` | Board's reply matches the auditor's opinion (s.134(3)(f)) | two or more documents |
| `XDOC-006` | Profit or loss is described consistently | two or more documents |
| `XDOC-007` | Directors' Report financial summary agrees with the statements | two or more documents |
| `XDOC-008` | Share capital change matches the Directors' Report | two or more documents |
| `XDOC-009` | Same directors sign the Directors' Report and the statements | two or more documents |
| `XDOC-010` | Auditor's term agrees between the Directors' Report and the notice | two or more documents |
| `XDOC-011` | Statements named in the audit opinion are in the package | two or more documents |
| `XDOC-012` | Registered office address agrees across documents | two or more documents |
| `XDOC-013` | Papers the notice asks members to adopt are in the package | two or more documents |
| `XDOC-014` | Dividend agrees between the Directors' Report and the notice | two or more documents |
| `XDOC-015` | Invoice is addressed to the company | two or more documents |
| `XDOC-016` | Services billed by the statutory auditor (s.144) | two or more documents |
| `XDOC-017` | Year-end invoice for the year's services is reflected in the statements | two or more documents |
